narrative: The market is grappling with a significant leadership crisis at Nvidia following the CEO's resignation amid espionage allegations and potential US government sanctions. This has triggered a sharp sell-off in the tech sector, weighing heavily on the Nasdaq 100. Despite these tech-specific headwinds, the broader S&P 500 remains resilient, trading near all-time highs. Geopolitical tensions between the US and China are intensifying, while the market also monitors fiscal challenges related to infrastructure and military spending. Overall, investor sentiment remains mixed as the tech sector faces a period of heightened volatility.

Nasdaq.why: Barry Ritholtz notes the index is down 10% from highs due to specific concerns regarding tech companies and their China exposure.

S&P 500.why: Barry Ritholtz highlights that the index is only 3.3% off all-time highs, suggesting the broader market is not solely dependent on tech performance.
